verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service platform with an operational dashboard, so AI-generated insights from customer and transaction data are a fair question for this kind of product. The pack contains no evidence of any in-product AI insight or suggestion feature. Related items do not count: the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes serve documentation to external AI tools, and the EDD and Customer Risk Rating material describes compliance workflows, not AI-generated insights.
